lines.trans: Hello Isabelle, are you doing well today?
Very well, Andrea, thank you very much.
Do you handle the director Sacha Hartman?
Yes, I take care of him.
I love his work, he is very talented.
Winning a Palme d'Or, that is wonderful.

words.gram: masculine singular; Palme d'Or = Cannes award

lines.trans: He has a very fine role for you.
Really? But I never solicit roles.
Isabelle prefers that a director asks her.
Directors also like to feel wanted.

words.gram: past participle used as adjective, masculine plural

lines.trans: We had better read the script.

words.gram: conditional, 3sg; on ferait mieux = had better

lines.trans: Sacha is in Paris right now.
All right, but please, be discreet.
Yes, of course, I call him now.

words.gram: adjective, masculine singular; bien sûr = of course
